description: Notes are inserted at the first important use of a historical term. Chapter files remain paragraph-aligned with the source.

notes.text: Netherfield Park is a large country house with its own private land. Mr. Bingley rents it. Park does not mean a public city park here.
A carriage pulled by four horses was fast and expensive. It showed that the traveller was wealthy.
Michaelmas is 29 September. Rents, jobs, and agreements often began or ended on this traditional date.
Four or five thousand pounds a year was a very large income. Exact comparisons with modern money are difficult.
A first formal visit was important. After Mr. Bennet visited, the women of his family could visit Mr. Bingley and meet him.
A ball was an important social event. Young women and men could meet there. Everyone noticed who danced together.
Longbourn is the Bennet family's house and country estate. It is close to the small town of Meryton.
Meryton is a small market town. The Bennets can walk there from Longbourn.
Pemberley is Mr. Darcy's great house and estate in Derbyshire. The estate provides much of his wealth and gives him many responsibilities.
This legal rule prevents the Bennet daughters from inheriting Longbourn. After Mr. Bennet dies, it must pass to the next male heir.
The militia was a military force mainly used for defence at home. This regiment stays near Meryton for several months, and its officers join local social life.
Hunsford is a village in the English county of Kent.
A wealthy person could own the right to choose a clergyman for an open parish position. The position provided a house and income.
Rosings is Lady Catherine de Bourgh's great house and estate in Kent. Mr. Collins lives very close to it.
Brighton is a seaside town in southern England. It was a fashionable place for bathing and entertainment. The regiment is also stationed there.
Gretna Green is just across the Scottish border. Young couples from England could marry there more easily and without their parents' consent.
